GREG, 2026-11-16 about 00:07Z, relayed by Engram::Asistant (mailbox 43498a6e #1325, message 3a9207af), verbatim: „Nic nie ruszam. Nie jestem przy komputerze. Mogą ubić chrome.exe jak chcą.” Scope per Asistant: agents may close Chrome on Central when the memory is needed for work, coordinating resources, and continue EO and sync.
Practice: only chrome.exe, never engram.exe or any TermAl process. Stop it only when a pre-spawn census on Central is below the floor (FreeVirtualMemory below 16,777,216 KiB), then re-census and record what was stopped on the work item or in the slot message. Opus2 owns the Central schedule and was told (mailbox 28ccc255 #1001). At 00:08Z host 285K had 25,659,428 KiB free virtual memory, so nothing was stopped then.
